# Isaiah Chapter 38 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 22 verses]*

*Fifteen years added; sundial sign; Hezekiah's psalm of thanksgiving; life from the pit*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** I shall go softly all my years because of the bitterness of my soul. This chapter fifteen years added.

*-- LOGOS*
